description: This is a React functional component for editing MCP server configurations within a web UI. It manages form state, integrates with OAuth flow, fetches tools, and handles updating server data with various configurations including authentication, permission management, and cost settings.

methods.name: fetchTools
methods.description: Fetches list of available tools from the MCP server, handling OAuth tokens if necessary.

methods.name: getAccessGroupOptions
methods.description: Generates options for access groups, including creating a new group option based on search term.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Submits the updated MCP server configuration after validation and transformation of form data.
